meta.name: review-work
meta.description: Post-implementation gate review: run manual QA on the real surface yourself, then launch ONE gate reviewer (never a panel) to audit goal, constraints, code quality, security, missed context, and QA evidence. Use before a PR handoff or when the user explicitly asks to review completed work.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 交付代码前先自己跑一遍人工验收,再让一名审查者逐项把关目标、约束、质量与安全
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果每次提 PR 前都担心漏掉验收步骤或质量问题
copy.tagline_en: Run your own manual QA, then one focused gate review before the PR handoff
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want a consistent quality gate before every PR handoff.

howto.what: 做完实现后，Claude 会自己到真实界面上手工跑一遍 QA 并留下证据，再启动一个（不是一组）门禁评审者，核对目标、约束与代码质量等。只有 QA 全过且评审者 APPROVE，才算通过。
howto.when: 当你准备做 PR 交接，或明确要求评审已完成的工作时触发，由它接管这次评审：先手工 QA，再启动门禁评审者。

say.text: 帮我评审刚完成的这个改动
say.note: 它先跑手工 QA，再启动门禁评审者

say.text: PR 交接前，对这次改动做一轮门禁评审
say.note: 按两轮评审流程给出通过或失败结论

say.text: 按 review-work 做手工 QA 和门禁评审
say.note: QA 有失败行就直接报 REVIEW FAILED

howto.what_en: After implementation, Claude runs hands-on QA on the real surface and records evidence, then spawns ONE gate reviewer (never a panel) to audit goal, constraints and quality. It passes only if no QA row fails and the reviewer APPROVES.
howto.when_en: Triggers before a PR handoff, or when you explicitly ask to review completed work; it takes over the review then.

say_en.text: Review the change I just finished
say_en.note: Hands-on QA first, then one gate reviewer

say_en.text: Do a gate review before the PR handoff
say_en.note: Gives a pass or fail verdict from both lanes

say_en.text: Run review-work: manual QA plus gate review
say_en.note: A failing QA row reports REVIEW FAILED
